```sql
SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.Phone,
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgScrWriteScore
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE 
    s.OpenDate > '1991-01-01' 
    AND s.ClosedDate <= '2000-12-31'
GROUP BY 
    s.CDSCode, s.School, s.Phone
HAVING 
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    AvgScrWriteScore DESC;
```

  AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL

LIMIT 1;

ORDER BY TotalViews DESC;

JOIN posts p ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId

GROUP BY u.Id, u.Reputation, u.CreationDate
HAVING MAX(Reputation) > 0

SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE r.raceId = 348
  AND cr.laps = 0
  AND cr.fastestLap = 0
  AND cr.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cr.fastestLapTime ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

    d.forename AS driver_name,

FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN lapTimes l ON r.raceId = l.raceId AND l.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE l(milliseconds) = (

    FROM lapTimes
    WHERE raceId = r.raceId
)
ORDER BY l(milliseconds) ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.number, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob,
       MIN(l.time) AS earliest_lap_time
FROM races r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN constructorResults cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN laps l ON cr.raceId = l.raceId AND l.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Germany'
  AND d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob <= '1990-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.number, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
ORDER BY earliest_lap_time ASC
LIMIT 3;

    EXAMINATION.EXAMINATION_DATE,
    EXAMINATION.SYMPTOMS,
    EXAMINATION.DIAGNOSIS

  AND P.Birthday > (SELECT MIN(Birthday) FROM Patient)

    t.TransactionID,
    t.CustomerID,
    t.GasStationID,
    t.Date,
    t.Time,
    t.Amount,
    t.Price,
    t.Country,
    t.ProductID,
    t.CustomerID,
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Segment,
    c.Currency,
    cs.Country,
    cs.Segment

JOIN yearmonth y ON t.Date = y.Date AND t.CustomerID = y.CustomerID

  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'

  AND t.Amount > 0;
